$sources: GB 50223-2008 (seismic fortification categories 甲 乙 丙 丁)
source: GB 50223-2008: the seismic fortification categories in SAEngine's slots I-IV (丁 I, 丙 II, 乙 III, 甲 IV). GB 50011 does not raise the earthquake forces by category (乙 and 丙 take the site's intensity; 乙 raises the measures by one degree, see seismic.seismicGrades.raise; 甲 takes a site-specific study, not covered): the seismic importance is 1.0 for all; wind importance 1.0 (GB 50009 8.1.2: tall buildings sensitive to wind take 1.1 w0, a project override).

III.description: 乙类 (Category B): key buildings (schools, hospitals, large public buildings)

IV.description: 甲类 (Category A): special buildings (site-specific study needed)
